title: Marchland Oaths 1.6.0 render benchmark against the v1.5.3 baseline
scene: tests/render_benchmark.gd rainy village, normal difficulty, 60 warm-up frames then 180 measured frames at 1280x720, Compatibility renderer, Dummy audio, fresh profile per run
display_cap_note: Both trees report about 60 FPS, which is the display refresh cap, so FPS works as a pass/fail signal rather than a fine-grained comparison. Load time and draw calls are the discriminating measurements, and load time itself varies between runs, which is why every raw sample and the median are recorded.
baseline_note: The baseline worktree is the published v1.5.3 tree (01f7174), the immediate predecessor of this edition, measured on the same host in the same session.
limits: Six single runs on one Windows host with an AMD integrated GPU. This is a smoke comparison, not a statistically rigorous performance study.
